scope: Production single-file archives, serial seeded randomized jobs, three repetitions, eight requested CPU workers (ZIP serial). Whole-process create/extract times plus common output fsync; includes startup, sampling, checksums and IO. RAR 3/5 with 32 MiB dictionary; ZIP Deflate 1/6. No GPU. OS cache, thermals, placement and background load uncontrolled. Development corpus, not a holdout or exhaustive tuning. Original numeric representations, no conversion. Exact SHA256 recovery outside timing.
